spawn-tuner.intro: Unticked settings stay at the world's own value. Percent: 100% is vanilla, 200% is double, 0% turns it off.
spawn-tuner.after: Put it in the mod folder, then type  spawns reload  and  spawns refresh  in the server console.

hints.*Density: none, default, or a number (the game's range is 1 to 5)

blood-moon-sound.intro: Your own sound files still go in the mod folder next to this file.
blood-moon-sound.after: Put it in the mod folder, then type  bmsound reload  or restart the game.

blood-moon-sound.title: Discord posts
blood-moon-sound.summary: Paste your Discord webhook, pick which blood moon posts you want and how they read, and download a ready discord.txt for your server.
blood-moon-sound.intro: Server only: players don't need this file. Every message can use the placeholders below, and the first line of a message is its headline. \n starts a new line.
blood-moon-sound.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server (never in a zip you give players), then type  bmdiscord reload  and  bmdiscord test  in the server console.

hints.LeaderboardHour: Hour on the server PC's own clock, 0 to 23
hints.*EveryHours: In-game hours between posts, 0 to 24 (0 = off)
hints.InGameChatFor: Comma separated: reminder, countdown, start, update, end, death, laststanding, leaderboard, schedule, serverstart, serverstop, join, leave, or all

remove-any-entity.intro: Pick what stops spawning, what stops only in some biomes, and what gets swapped for something else. A name covers all its versions (feral, radiated, charged, infernal).
remove-any-entity.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server, then type  rae reload  in the server console.

hints.Replacement: Spawned instead when removals leave a spawn spot with nothing at all

zombie-and-animal-bait.title: Discord posts
zombie-and-animal-bait.summary: Paste your Discord webhook and download a ready webhook.txt, so rare tames, level milestones and evolutions are posted to your channel.
zombie-and-animal-bait.intro: Server only. Already running Blood Moon Sound with a discord.txt? Bait uses that webhook when it has no webhook.txt, so you can skip this.
zombie-and-animal-bait.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server (never in a zip you give players), then restart the server.
